advisories.title: A folded blockers-array advisory remains classified under notFoldedThisSuccessor
advisories.evidence: Claude v3 ADV-1 and Codex v3 LQMCV3-A1 both identify the missing blockers: [] on codexv1. V5 restores codexv1 with blockers: [], its honestyRepairsFromV4 entry says so, and the notFoldedThisSuccessor text itself says it was restored this generation. The finding is therefore folded while its containing property classifies it as not folded.
advisories.whyOnlyAdvisory: No finding is hidden and the text reports the repair accurately; only the structural status is incoherent. The pinned predecessor bytes make the state recoverable, and contract semantics are unaffected.
advisories.suggestedRepair: Leave notFoldedThisSuccessor empty, or remove the resolved item from it, and keep the completed repair solely in honestyRepairsFromV4 or an explicitly folded ledger.

advisories.title: The DR-103 half of the manifest-boundary activation dependency remains implicit
advisories.evidence: The pinned D-007 turn-2 OBS-D007-T2-02 says DR-103 and DR-125 both must close before matrix authoring and routes manifest/host-contract divergence to both closure acts. V5 explicitly gates only on DR-125. The live DR-103 row remains OPEN at review HEAD; D-106 records an accepted fixture-corpus candidate but explicitly does not SATISFY DR-103.
advisories.whyOnlyAdvisory: The manifestIsBoundary rule and the requirement to enumerate advertised manifest capabilities make the missing manifest closure implicit, no matrix is authored here, and OBS-D007-T2-02 was non-blocking. Naming both owners would preserve the accepted route without relying on implication.
advisories.suggestedRepair: When this block next changes, name both DR-103 and DR-125 closure or scoped disposition as activation prerequisites and leave divergence ownership to their recorded closure acts.

It is not acceptable at review HEAD 8fdd59c because its sole asserted current COORD measurement is still the v3-era b9819d6e… snapshot; live bytes are 39f372e1… after D-106.
